name: Restart sampling
plain: Periodically jumps back up in noise level by adding a large amount of fresh noise, then re-solves that segment with a deterministic solver. Trades steps for contraction of earlier errors.
math:
restart_list format {min_σ:[steps,times,max_σ]}. Auto: if steps≥20: 9 restart steps, 1 time (steps≥36: steps//4, 2 times), {0.1:[n+1,t,2]}; below 20 steps no restart.
Walk step_list; whenever the next σ_old > last σ: x ← x + ε·s_noise·√(σ_old²−σ_last²), then Heun step.

props.normalizes_variance: yes for the σ increase; injection uses global RNG, not a noise sampler

label: from code
surprise: In auto mode it replaces your schedule: sigmas are rebuilt as Karras between sigmas[-2] and sigmas[0] (restart_sampling.py:48), so the chosen scheduler stops mattering when steps ≥ 20.
